sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
minor maintenance P1, which must be performed from eight to twelve years and 
after 2500 switching cycles 1 bases as indicated by Y8:12 in the title block

The technical specification of the CB Max. Rated voltage = 145kv, rated voltage 
= 132kv, Rated current = 1250 A, short-circuit current 31.5 KA

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Abd Allah Elaiwah Sayed at High Dam 
Power Station, accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad: general director, 
approved by eng. Abde: Karem Abu Zaid: High Dam head Sector, and certified by 
eng. Kamel Ragheb Haleem: EPGC quality control general director, MPIS 
Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

items:
Wear 
 standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, rubber gloves, ... etc.
Switch off the disconnectors on CB sides and grounded the CB sides
Switch off DC & AC supply (CB is electrically dead)

Switch off the charging current DC motor wound 
 spring
The CB in not under pressure (all compressed air is released)

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Portable air blower, metal brush

Set of common screw drivers, cleaning material (arg, cloth), water pump, metal 
 wires
Densimeter test equipment, double open-ended spanner
Set set to refill connector
Lubricating grease for sf6 L... 44
Ohmmeter and slow close device

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check and presence of any 
abnormal noise

Check and presence of 
surface defects or cracks at breaking unit and supporting insulators

Check the tightening of 
bolts and nuts

Check the mechanism of 
operation

Measure the bending of 
drive rod (< 3mm)
Inspect the functioning of heaters
Record counter reading of operations counter

Clean the insulations and check for defects or 
cracks

sections.text:
State of Arcing Contacts (Determine the maximum 
admissible wear)

Connect circuit indicator to primary H.V terminals 
of pole A

For measuring of xa, slowly move the C.B with the 
help of slow close device from the on - position towards the off - position

Measure dimension xa upon electrical contact 
separation (beep tone stops, lamp goes out) and record it
Repeat measurement at least twice and record xao
Repeat steps 1,2,3 and 4 for poles B and C

For every pole evaluate the admissible limiting 
value K < 6mm (K=Xa - Xao)

If K of 6mm has been reached, reconditioning of 
contacts is necessary

sections.text: Densimeter Switching Points

items:
Open isolating terminal for signals S1 
 (signal 1" top - up") and S2 (signal 2 witch and lock) wound spring 
 operating mechanism
Connect terminal for S1 to line tester

Connect densimeter test device to densimeter 
 support
Open the nozzle of densimeter test device

When line tester reacts close nozzle and 
 record reading S1/bar

Compare S1 with the theoretically determined 
 pressure value and repeat measurement

On apparatus side, connect line tester to 
 terminals for S2

Conduct measurement for S2 according to 
 measurement for S1 with repetition

Nominal values: 
 Pressure difference S1 - S2 = 0.3 0.1 bar 
 S2 = S2 (according to calculation) 0.2 bar

If the deviation 
 exceeds the tolerance, densimeter should be correct

State of rated current carrying circuit (measurement 
 the DC resistance of contacts by using the ohmmeter) (reference value 
 < 40 
 Ω
